data: Same Luh-Blank 104 scored cells, same round-3 partitions (audit/cell_partitions.csv), same round-3 trainer (trainer/exp_lib.py) and r3.py helpers, copied unmodified.
R4A_origin_specific_search: For each origin in {10,15,20} and each family: 20 random settings (equal budget) drawn from an origin-specific space in which the information set (full F7+Q or capacity-history-only) is a tuned dimension. Fit on role=fit, select on equal-cell recursive validation Q-MAPE (role=validation), seed 42, search schedule.
R4B_refit: Winner per family/fold/origin refitted with seeds 42/52/62 (final schedule) on fit+calibration cells; neural early stopping on the validation cells; trees on fit+calibration+validation. Calibration cells therefore no longer support split-conformal claims for R4 models (round-3 intervals remain the conformal evidence).
R4C_pooled: History-only SOH (Q/Q0) GRU and XGBoost. Arm pooled: training adds every cell of Sandia(SNL, 80), Oxford(8) and Kirkaldy(40) to the Luh-Blank fit+calibration cells; arm source_only: Luh-Blank fit+calibration only; same configuration (the fold/origin R4A validation-best history-only trial of that family), same seeds, same validation/test cells. Mirror study on Sandia (origins 5, 8; Sandia folds; configuration = Sandia fold-selected setting with history-only input).
R4D_hybrid: Per-cell prior = lag-one sqrt fit on k (days when k is constant in the prefix), slope<=0, as round-3 sqrt_k_lag1. A direct XGBoost learns the residual SOH - prior from training cells over simulated origins (every 2nd checkup from 8, or from 3 for Sandia); features: steps ahead, prior forecast, last SOH, last prior residual, mean residual over prefix, recent slope, origin length, coordinate gap, static descriptors. 6 pre-listed XGB settings, chosen on validation cells at the evaluation origin; seeds 42/52/62.
combinations: Equal-weight, per seed: ARIMA + R4 XGB; ARIMA + R4 best-validation neural; ARIMA + R4D hybrid.
statistics: Equal-cell Q-MAPE (steps -> seeds -> cells); bootstrap 10000 seed 20261005; paired Wilcoxon on 104 cells; Holm within named families r4_vs_ARIMA_origin{o} and r4_vs_round3_origin{o}. No equivalence claims.

R4E_transfer_hybrid_added.added: 2026-10-07 ~11:15 UTC, after R4D Luh/Sandia hybrid results were seen, before any Kirkaldy hybrid computation
R4E_transfer_hybrid_added.design: Unit-free hybrid for a new cell format: index-based lag-one sqrt prior (axis = checkup index) + XGBoost residual learner trained on ALL Luh-Blank, Sandia and Oxford cells (simulated origins every checkup from 3), features step, origin, prior, last_soh, last_res, mean_abs_res, slope, gap only. Fixed a-priori configuration max_depth=3, n_estimators=200, lr=0.05, subsample=colsample=0.8; seeds 42/52/62. Applied unchanged to the 40 Kirkaldy LG M50T cells at origins 3, 5 and 8 (cells with more checks than the origin). Controls on the same prefixes: index sqrt prior alone, ARIMA_AICc, persistence. No Kirkaldy data used for fitting or selection.

R4F_ablations_added.added: 2026-10-07 ~11:45 UTC, after R4D/R4E results were seen; before any ablation, Xuan-style, fine-tuned Chronos, hybrid-interval or hybrid-decision computation

variants.V1_main: sqrt prior + fit diagnostics (last_res, mean_abs_res) + training over all simulated origins (as R4D)
variants.V2_no_diag: as V1 without last_res and mean_abs_res
variants.V3_single_origin: as V1 but training rows only from the evaluation origin
variants.V4_linear_prior: lag-one linear prior on the same axis, otherwise as V1
variants.V5_persistence_anchor: no fitted prior: residual relative to last measured SOH; prior-derived features removed
variants.V6_xuan_style: Xuan et al. (JES 149, 120396, 2026) structure with our information set: per-cell ARIMA_AICc (round-3 univariate.py) forecast as prior + XGBoost residual on step, origin, ARIMA forecast, last SOH, slope, k_prev, Q0, static descriptors; training origins every 4th checkup from 8 (Luh) / every checkup from 3 (Sandia)

R4F_ablations_added.selection: Each variant: same 6 XGB settings, chosen on inner validation at the evaluation origin; seeds 42/52/62; Luh trained on fit+calibration, Sandia on fit.
R4F_ablations_added.transfer_sources: Kirkaldy zero-target transfer with sources {Luh}, {Sandia}, {Luh+Sandia}, {Luh+Sandia+Oxford(main)}; plus persistence-anchor variant with all sources.
R4F_ablations_added.intervals: Luh: hybrid V1 refitted on fit cells only; absolute capacity residuals on the 20 independent calibration cells per fold, per step and seed (round-3 rule: rank ceil((n+1)q), infinite if insufficient); 80/90% coverage and width on test. Sandia: CV+-style as in the Sandia extras.
R4F_ablations_added.decisions: 80%-SOH crossing precision/recall/F1, last-step APE, signed bias, optimistic share for hybrid, avg_ARIMA_hybrid and the reference methods, computed with one common script.
R4F_ablations_added.chronos_finetune: Chronos-Bolt-small (pinned weights) fine-tuned per outer fold on training-cell SOH sequences (contexts = prefixes of every length >=3, targets = following checkups, quantile loss), AdamW lr 5e-5, batch 32, checkpoints at 200/400/600 steps chosen by inner-validation equal-cell MAPE; evaluated zero-shot-style on the same test prefixes at Luh 10/15/20 and Sandia 5/8.
R4F_ablations_added.chronos_finetune_amendment: Before any fine-tuning result was seen: encoder (and shared/input-patch embeddings) frozen, decoder and output head trained (27.7M of 47.7M parameters), because full fine-tuning took ~6 s/step on the 2-core cloud machine. Single training seed 42.

R4G_reviewer_robustness_added.added: 2026-10-07 ~13:05 UTC, after R4D/R4E/transfer-ablation results; before any R4G computation
R4G_reviewer_robustness_added.G1_oxford_confirmation: Frozen unit-free hybrid (R4E features/setting, sources Luh+Sandia only; Oxford never used for any hybrid fitting or selection) applied to the 8 Oxford cells at origins 5, 10, 20, including long horizons (to the end of each record). Controls: index sqrt prior, ARIMA_AICc, persistence; round-3 Oxford Chronos/learned results quoted from round-3 tables at origin 20. Error reported by horizon bucket.
R4G_reviewer_robustness_added.G2_knee_subsets: Knee cell (pre-declared): fade rate per checkup over the last third of the cell record exceeds twice the rate over the first third. Report hybrid vs ARIMA vs sqrt prior separately for knee and non-knee cells (Luh, Sandia, Kirkaldy).
R4G_reviewer_robustness_added.G3_no_schedule: Hybrid V7: checkup-index axis only (no cycle count, no elapsed time, no k feature); static descriptors kept; otherwise as V1 (Luh fit+calibration, Sandia fit; 6 settings chosen on validation; 3 seeds).
R4G_reviewer_robustness_added.G4_noise_dropout: Round-3 perturbed origin-20 prefixes (noise 0/0.5/1% of Q0, drops 0/10/25%, 3 replicates, truth unchanged) fed to the trained Luh hybrid (V1, fit+calibration models refitted per fold, seeds 42/52/62); prior fit and features on observed prefix points only. Compared with round-3 ARIMA/learned robustness cell errors.
R4G_reviewer_robustness_added.G5_mondrian_conformal: Group-conditional split conformal on the 20 calibration cells: radius per fold/origin/seed/ageing regime/step bucket {1,2,3,4-6,7+}; coverage reported per regime alongside the marginal per-step version.
R4G_reviewer_robustness_added.G6_arima_weight: Weight w in {0,.25,.5,.75,1} on ARIMA in w*ARIMA+(1-w)*hybrid chosen per fold/origin on inner-validation equal-cell MAPE (Luh validation role; Sandia validation cells); applied to test.
R4G_reviewer_robustness_added.G7_chronos_full_ft: Optional, last: Sandia only, full-model fine-tuning, lr 1e-5 and 5e-5, 300 steps, checkpoints 100/200/300 by validation.
